title: Wolf and Ember
author: Paloma Montrose
blurb: Silas Yarrow, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
